ui.heroLead: An independent game studio making colorful puzzle games for the little breaks in your day.
ui.aboutBody: We build small worlds around one simple move. A tap frees a fish, a bird hops to the next branch, and a puzzle begins to unfold.
ui.contactBody: For game support, artwork permissions or privacy requests, write to Littlejoy Games.

bubble-fish.name: Bubble Fish
bubble-fish.note: Tap a bubble and guide the fish to its tank before the waiting spots fill up.

guide.title: Make room for three
guide.text: Send three fish of the same kind to the matching tank. A full tank clears the way for the next group.

guide.title: Read the queue
guide.text: Only the first fish in a bubble can leave. Look at the fish behind it before using your last waiting spot.

fly-home.name: Fly Home
fly-home.note: Move birds between branches, gather matching flocks and guide them home through ten woodland worlds.

guide.title: Gather a flock
guide.text: Look for birds of the same color. Move them between branches, keeping a spare perch for the next move.

guide.title: Beyond the branches
guide.text: Plan around sleeping birds and eggs. Stars earned in the levels open reward chests, and collected outfits dress up your flock.

intros.games: Two puzzle games with different rhythms. Make space for the next fish underwater, or choose the branch that brings a flock together.
intros.worlds: Travel from the shallows to a clockwork bay, then from bamboo groves to wisteria. Each journey has its own collection.
intros.guide: A closer look at the decisions behind a good move. Use these situations to plan your next rescue or homecoming.
intros.support: Find out where your progress is kept, what to include in a bug report, and how to request permission to use our artwork.

bubble-fish.world: The 360 levels span 18 seas, from Sunrise Shore and Coral Garden to Clockwork Bay and Melody Cove. The waters change as you work through the puzzles.
bubble-fish.collection: The collection has 18 albums with 705 sea creatures in all. Return to the albums between levels to see which creatures you have already found.
bubble-fish.tacticTitle: When only one waiting spot is left
bubble-fish.tactic: Look at the open tanks before tapping. A third fish of the right kind completes a tank immediately. Choosing a fish with no matching tank uses the last waiting spot instead.

fly-home.world: Follow 210 puzzles through ten painted forests. Bamboo gives way to autumn leaves, snow and blossom before the flock reaches the wisteria trees.
fly-home.collection: Careful moves earn up to three stars per level. Stars open reward chests. Back at the aviary, try outfits on the birds you have collected.
fly-home.tacticTitle: When a branch is almost full
fly-home.tactic: Check the birds at the tips of two branches. A matching group can land on a branch with room and the same kind at its tip. Keep an empty branch free until you know which group needs it most.

faq.question: Where is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Both games save progress on the device. For a browser game, return in the same browser profile. Clearing its site data or deleting the iOS app can erase that progress.

faq.question: What should I include in a bug report?
faq.answer: Tell us the game, level, device and what you tapped just before the issue. Add the app version if you know it. Please leave out passwords and personal documents.

faq.question: May I use a poster or illustration?
faq.answer: You may share links to our public pages. For commercial use or a collection of images, send us the page address and explain how you would like to use the art.

studio.title: A different kind of pause
studio.text: In the ocean, the next fish in a queue can change your plan. In the forest, an empty branch does the same. Both games give you room to pause, look at the board and choose one move.
